part: Watchlist page composition — the real WatchlistSurface (not a shell primitive fed invented props)
source: dc.html p11 (#p11): masthead (VOL line, WATCHLIST, scope line 'N watched · personal · M shared by the workspace', command bar placeholder 'Search your watchlist — or ask "what changed on my watched items?"'), then a 1fr/300px body — content column: Watched card (SectionHeading 'Watched · N' + 'Sorted by next date', column header Juris./Title · type · modes/Impact low → high/Next date/Timeline/Tier, rows, CardFoot + 'Browse regulations →', the changed-since-last-visit state note) then the Recalculation notices card; rail: Filters, Share with workspace, Legend.
notes: This spec exists per the operator's own composition complaint ('you are NOT matching the images directly'): it measures the page REGION BY REGION IN DOCUMENT ORDER, so a future regression that drops the column header, drops the card foot, drops the notices card, or puts the filters back into the content column is caught here rather than in a screenshot review.
Placement is asserted with sibling-combinator selectors wherever 'present but in the wrong place' is the defect being guarded — order, not mere presence.

Artboard 11's rail draws only two cards. The Filters card is the app's own scope/type/tag facets, which the artboard does not draw at all: ruling R7 keeps the feature and the operator's 2026-09-07 filters ruling puts it in the rail, so it is asserted here in rail position 1 exactly as on the other four list surfaces. Logged in DEVIATION-LOG.md.

Fixture data is invented with the real prop shape (6 WatchlistItems, 4 notices, 2 workspace tags) and is never shipped and never asserted on; the assertions are geometry, placement and the components' own static labels.

forbid.name: D-M4: no list row carries more than one absence token
forbid.reason: D-M4 (operator mobile report 2026-09-08) [CONFIRMED at 1440 and at 390]. The impact, due and tier cells each rendered their own <Absence>, so a row missing all three drew a dashed baseline plus UNSCORED plus PENDING plus NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE — three tokens, the third on a line of its own. Ruling 2.1 allows exactly ONE reason per row. This selector matches a row carrying a token in TWO of the three cells, which is the defect and nothing else. The structural guarantee is ListRow's `reasonSlot`.
